title: All branches downloads every other branch's whole history each time it is opened
what: When an owner opens the All branches page, the admin app fetches every other branch's full records (all members, plans, receipts and every check-in ever made) from the start, because it keeps no saved copy of the other branches. A gym with three branches of 500+ members and a few years of check-ins waits for several large downloads on a phone on 4G, every visit, before the totals appear.
expected: The other branches open from a saved copy and fetch only what changed, or the server sends just the totals and short lists this page shows.
who: owners with two or more branches
how_often: every time All branches is opened in a new visit
fix_line: Keep a saved copy of each branch and fetch only changes, or ask the server for the page's totals only

title: Each letter typed in the All branches member search re-sorts every branch's whole history
what: The 'Find a member in any branch' box searches again on every key press, and each search re-groups every plan, receipt and check-in of every branch, even though only the matching members are shown. In a big gym with several branches the box can lag on a cheap phone while typing a name or number.
expected: Typing stays instant: the search waits for a short pause and only works out the members that match.
who: owners with two or more branches
how_often: every key press in the search box
fix_line: Build each branch's member list once and filter it; wait for a pause before searching
